Cedar Crest — a villa, restyled.

Keeping the structure of a Gurgaon villa, two design routes were drawn for the facade and interiors: a restrained "Classical Restyling", and a bold, modern "French Retro Chic". The black-and-white retro route won — sharp, purposeful lines outside; black banisters and white marble within, lit mostly by daylight.

Residential interior & facade design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·50.
